name: Dinah
bio:
Dinah is the daughter of Jacob and Leah, the only daughter of Jacob's children named in Scripture. She went out to visit the women of the land and was seen and violated by Shechem, a Hivite; afterward Shechem genuinely fell in love with her and begged his father Hamor to arrange their marriage (Genesis 34:1-4).

When Dinah's brothers learned of her violation, they were furious, and schemed to demand that every male in Shechem's city be circumcised as a condition for the marriage; while the men of the city were still in pain from the procedure, Simeon and Levi took their swords and killed every male, rescuing Dinah, while the other brothers plundered the city's wealth and took its women and children captive (Genesis 34:5-29). Jacob was deeply troubled by his sons' violence, fearing it would provoke reprisal from the surrounding peoples — this tense and morally complicated account also forms the background for Jacob's later deathbed rebuke of Simeon and Levi (Genesis 49:5-7).
